notes: data.prices.SSE.dividend_source: no cited SSE Composite dividend yield was found (SSE and CSIndex sources searched), so the SSE sleeve earns the index price return without dividends; this understates SSE total returns of invested days and is a limitation (SPEC §2.1 fallback).
ltsf.*: mean (and standard deviation) over seeds 0-2 of the test MSE and MAE on standardised data, all channels, every test window; no reversible instance normalisation (not part of SPEC §15).
data.news.market.*: means and shares over trading days 2010-01-01 .. 2025-12-31 (policy start to the end of the news date range); by-year shares cover every panel year.
sentiflow.pooled: union of the test splits of phrasebank50, fiqa and twitter (phrasebank_all is a subset of phrasebank50 and is not counted twice).

sentiflow.<DS>.SF: calibrated SentiFlow; A, A_REV and B are the raw branches (their calibration is in sentiflow.calibration_b for B). sentiflow.calibration.temperature is the mean of the five per-seed temperatures.
